digest.component_or_area: fsck and git utilities module reorganization
propositions: Three filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are currently defined in fsck_repair.py but have no structural reason to be there and are imported by seven production modules, creating an inverted dependency where a store-layer module depends on a command-layer repair module

The three primitives must be moved from src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py to src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py while preserving two compatibility surfaces: module-level re-exports in fsck.py and fsck_repair.py that existing tests patch via monkeypatch.setattr()
Moving the primitives must not introduce circular imports; gitutil must remain a stdlib-only leaf module with zero module-level rebar.* imports
All seven direct consumers (fsck_scan, fsck, gitutil, fsck_recover, compact, bridge_repair, tracker_maintenance) must be repointed to import from gitutil instead of fsck_repair or fsck
